_comment: andr36oid-authored, not an upstream Daijishou file: the Ports game system. Each entry is a dArkOSen port (.sh) living on the shared EASYROMS store; the player hands it to the SubsystemBridge activity, which triggers the root broker to run it on a framework-down display handoff.
